content.body: 5. The will of man is made perfectly and immutably free to good alone, in the state of glory only.

content.title: Chapter 9: Of Free Will

content_with_prooftexts.body: 5. The will of man is made perfectly and immutably free to good alone, in the state of glory only.1
content_with_prooftexts.name: Confession of Faith

prooftexts.1:
Hebrews 12:23

and to the assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God, the judge of all, and to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

1 John 3:2

Beloved, we are God’s children now, and what we will be has not yet appeared; but we know that when he appears we shall be like him, because we shall see him as he is.

Jude 24

Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you blameless before the presence of his glory with great joy,

Revelation 21:27

But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is detestable or false, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

(ESV)
